rules.conflictOrdinance: School Board of Miami-Dade County Bylaws and Policies: Policy 0141.2 Conflict of Interest (Board members; referenced in agenda item H-7, 2023-11-15, https://pdfs.dadeschools.net/Bdarch/2023/Bd111523/agenda/h7rev.pdf); policy manual at https://policies.dadeschools.net/ (the policy page itself could not be fetched). Board members are also subject to Miami-Dade County Code Sec. 2-11.1 (the County ethics code applies to the School Board by its terms as to the Commission on Ethics' jurisdiction): https://library.municode.com/fl/miami_-_dade_county/codes/code_of_ordinances?nodeId=PTIIICOOR_CH2AD_ARTIINGE_S2-11.1COINCOET
rules.abstentionRule: F.S. 112.3143(3) (local public officers, including school board members): no vote on a measure inuring to the special private gain or loss of the member, a principal, a relative or a business associate; state the interest before the vote; file a memorandum (Form 8B) within 15 days with the person recording the minutes. https://www.leg.state.fl.us/Statutes/index.cfm?App_mode=Display_Statute&URL=0100-0199/0112/Sections/0112.3143.html
rules.ethicsBody: Miami-Dade Commission on Ethics and Public Trust (https://ethics.miamidade.gov/) and Florida Commission on Ethics (https://ethics.state.fl.us/). Financial disclosure: Form 6 via EFDMS.
